description: Enhance the document merge confirmation dialog to display additional document details beyond just the title. This will help users distinguish between similarly named documents when merging, reducing the need to cross-reference with other windows. The dialog should maintain its current layout and functionality while adding relevant document metadata.
functional_requirements: Display document creation date alongside each document title in the merge dialog
Show document type/format (e.g., PDF, JPG) for each document in the merge dialog
Maintain the existing dialog structure and merge functionality while adding these new details
Ensure the additional details are clearly visible but don't overcrowd the dialog interface
Update both the HTML template and TypeScript component to support displaying the new document metadata
